model_materials.basis: Sellmeier law: the Sellmeier formula of CDGM D-ZK3-25 (CDGM optical glass catalogue 2026-09, cdgmgd.com); annealed at 25 C/h; wavelength in air, index relative to air (20 C, 101325 Pa); copied from public optical catalog 2026-11-25.1

index_reference.basis: glass catalogue convention: the formula takes wavelengths in air and gives the index relative to air at 20 C and 101325 Pa (the glass's reference temperature, 1 atm)

bulk_loss.basis: internal transmittance of CDGM D-ZK3-25 as its catalogue states it (IT lines: wavelength, internal transmittance, sample thickness; the thickest sample per wavelength), bulk only: no surface reflection

thermo_optic.basis: Schott dn/dT coefficients of CDGM D-ZK3-25 (the catalogue's TD line), reference temperature 20 C
